$comment: ONE neutral finish-boundary hook spec that WE own, carrying the harness-neutral METADATA for the finish hook. emit-harness-hooks.sh reads 'hooksDir' from here and compiles a native hook for each present harness (e.g. a Claude Stop hook). WHICH checks run is deliberately NOT listed here — it is discovered from the deployed check-*.sh set in hooksDir, the same glob the installer and the git pre-commit use, so the three can never disagree. This is deliberately NOT an APM hook primitive — APM's hook compilation is unreliable today, so we emit natively ourselves.
description: Spec-Driven Development close-out / status-sync / version guard. Blocks finishing while a SPEC-* spec's acceptance criteria, status, or version have drifted.
